svg.title: How gTranslate predicts a translation table
svg.desc: Prodigal calls genes under translation tables 11 and 4. Under table 11 genes stop at in-frame UGA codons; under table 4 they read through, raising coding density. Eight features (coding densities, GC content and UGA, UGG and glycine codon ratios) are passed to five classifiers (AdaBoost, decision tree, k-nearest neighbours, XGBoost, multi-layer perceptron) whose majority vote gives the translation table.

g.text: Genomes under 100 kb use Prodigal’s metagenome mode (-p meta)
